caseName: Florida ex rel. Hawkins v. Board of Control
caseNameFull: Florida ex rel. Hawkins v. Board of Control of Florida
attorneys: Robert L. Carter and Thurgood Marshall for petitioners., Richard W. Ervin, Attorney General of Florida, and Frank J. Heintz, Ralph M. McLane and Howard S. Bailey, Assistant Attorneys General, for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Florida denied for want of a final Judgment.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion certiorari should be granted.
